title: Indicator of an input bit
statement: For a binary string $y$ and an index $a\in\mathbb N$, the Boolean indicator of the language of encoded pairs whose indexed bit is true, evaluated at the encoding of $y$ and the binary representation of $a$, equals the bit of $y$ at index $a$, with out-of-range indices interpreted as false.
hypotheses_covered: An index a in the natural numbers
